title: The PDF shows the shop logo at the top when one is set; the CSV never includes a logo
custom_preconds:
1. You are signed in to the ShopView App on a desktop browser.
2. The shop has a logo set in its settings.
custom_steps:
1. Download the current tab as a PDF and look at the top of the document.
2. Download the current tab as a CSV and inspect the file.
custom_expected:
1. The PDF shows the shop logo at the top.
2. The CSV never includes a logo (plain data only).
